text: I usually wake up at six-thirty, and my day begins with a glass of water and a short stretching session. After a quick shower and breakfast, I leave for work around eight. My work schedule is pretty steady—I focus on tasks until lunch, then continue until five in the evening. On my way home, I stop by the gym for about forty minutes of cardio or light weights. Back home, I prepare dinner, reply to messages, and unwind by reading or watching a series. I’m in bed by ten-thirty. Keeping this routine consistent helps me feel productive and relaxed.
